title: Frontend Developer
description:
Department: IT Technical Work Arrangement: Work From Office Employment Type: Full Time Salary Range: Based on skills, experience, and interview performance Working Hours: 9:30 AM - 6:30 PM | Monday to Saturday - Required Skills: Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field. Proven experience as a Frontend Developer with a portfolio of web projects. Proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Bootstrap, and jQuery (including AJAX). Strong understanding of responsive design, cross-browser compatibility, and accessibility. Experience deploying websites on live servers (cPanel, FTP, DNS configuration, etc.). Familiar with trending web design principles and UX best practices. Good communication and teamwork skills. Description As a Frontend Developer at Smart 5 Solutions , you will be responsible for translating UI/UX designs into responsive, high-quality code. You will collaborate with designers and backend developers to deliver seamless user experiences across web applications. Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain user-facing features with clean and efficient code. Collaborate with designers to implement pixel-perfect designs. Optimize web pages for speed and scalability. Maintain code quality, organization, and automation. Stay up-to-date with emerging frontend trends and technologies. What We Offer: Competitive salary and benefits package. Opportunities for professional development and career growth. A creative and inclusive work environment. Chance to work on exciting projects with a passionate team.
